thread:
tim: quick heads-up 8:30am PT  ACME procurement approached sales: they want a 12-month reserved commitment specifically for embeddings with per-route QPS guarantees + a monthly burst pool. sales needs a term sheet ASAP. product/ops/legal — can we scope?
jess: noted. primary clarifying Q: do they require Hosted or Dedicated? Dedicated changes cost & SLA framing. @omar can you run a delta on sustained 20 QPS embeddings plus a 2x burst allowance over 30 days?
omar: doing a quick back-of-envelope. sustained 20 qps embeddings -> ~1.7B tokens/month on our accounting; maps to roughly X GPU-hours/day. infra incremental cost estimate ~= $18k/mo, plus ops ~0.2 FTE. Ill drop the spreadsheet with assumptions: https://goo.gl/example (preview).
liz: product suggestion: introduce an "Isolation Add-on" product line: reserved per-route QPS, configurable burst pool, priority batching. MVP scope: embeddings + rerank only, console control, billing SKU, routing flag/API parameter. ETA 8-10 weeks end-to-end.
neil: infra risks: reservation mustn't starve best-effort traffic. proposal: soft reservations (reserved slots scheduled but allow opportunistic preemption when idle) + automated fallback routing to lower-cost model variants. Need token-bucket tracked per-customer for burst accounting. Require canary plan (5 pilot tenants) and runbook.
sara: legal note: avoid absolute "guarantee" language. Recommend phrase: "commercially reasonable efforts to provide reserved capacity" and a defined credits formula when targets missed. Also recommend credit cap and exception carve-outs (force majeure, scheduled maintenance).
jess: suggested launch criteria: 1) billing SKU and pricing matrix, 2) console UI to set per-route QPS and burst pool, 3) routing policy + automated fallback, 4) runbook + SRE on-call and canary rollout with metrics, 5) legal-approved term language.
tim: Sales wants three options to propose: Starter (no reservation), Pro (reserved QPS, no SLA), Enterprise (reserved QPS + burst credits + SLA + premium support). @jess can you sketch pricing bands?
omar: initial cost scenarios: Pro ~$12k/mo (infra + 20% margin) for 20 qps baseline; Enterprise ~$28k/mo factoring SLA buffer and support. Break-evens depend heavily on utilization assumptions in spreadsheet.
liz: to shorten delivery, MVP to limit to embeddings model only (no generative outputs, no function-calling). Default to quantized embedding config to reduce GPU footprint.
neil: infra implementation notes: needs two scheduler features: per-tenant soft reservations and burst token buckets; estimate ~3 infra sprints + monitoring for token burn and preemption metrics. Also need a policy engine for fallback model routing.
jess: negotiation levers for ACME: cap monthly burst pool (e.g., 1M tokens), define fallback to best-effort route if exhausted, require 30-day notice for commit cancellation. Sales, confirm willingness to accept these.
tim: ACME countered: wants monthly price cap and no cancellation for first 6 months. Flag to finance for exposure analysis.
sara: also note: if ACME insists on private deployment, include data residency + KMS clauses; legal will draft variants for Hosted vs Private.
omar: updated spreadsheet with three pricing scenarios and sensitivity table: https://goo.gl/example2. Also included utilization sensitivity.
jess: owners & next steps: - jess: draft term sheet w/ three tiers & negotiation levers - liz: product spec (API flag, console controls, routing behaviors) - omar: finalize cost model & assumptions - neil: runbook + infra spec + canary plan - sara: contract language draft
marta-bot: created task PROD-4321: Roadmap -> Isolation Add-on (assignee: liz)
tim: propose weekly sync Tuesdays 10:00 PT.
jess: works for me.
liz: ack.
neil: ack.
sara: aiming to share draft by Friday.
omar: cost numbers ready by Friday.
tim: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
